Estimating each item in the photo:

- Oatmeal bowl: about 200 g, 120 kcal.
- Toast, 2 slices with butter: about 80 g, 230 kcal.
- Banana: about 100 g edible, 90 kcal.
- Eggs, 2 fried: about 100 g, 180 kcal.
- Avocado, about half: 70 g, 110 kcal.
- Lemon wedge: 10 g, 3 kcal.
- Orange drink: about 240 g, 110 kcal.
- Milk, about 240 g: 150 kcal for whole milk.

"Everything on the plate" could mean the whole meal, so I included all items.

Totals:
- Energy: 120 + 230 + 90 + 180 + 110 + 3 + 110 + 150 = 993 kcal.
- Mass: 200 + 80 + 100 + 100 + 70 + 10 + 240 + 240 = 1040 g.
